correctness.rationale: A complete partition by selected shore cardinalities excludes three-by-three and two-by-four configurations by explicit cycles, identifies two-by-two intersecting pairs and two-by-three nested pairs, counts each class, and proves both implications of inclusion maximality. value.rationale: The Max Min FVS literature studies inclusion-minimal cycle transversals, whereas a scalar minimum alone says nothing about large minimal transversals. Here a natural dense bipartite graph family has two explicit distinct minimal-FVS sizes n-1 and 2n-5 and an unbounded gap n-4, with exact labelled multiplicities. The all-forest enumerator determines every face count of the induced-forest complex; neither a routine normalization nor a narrow unmotivated cutoff.
